title: Minecraft Firework
blurb: Fireworks changed Minecraft twice. They arrived as pure decoration, and then the Elytra turned rocket-boosting into the fastest way to cross the world, so this whoosh-and-crack became the sound of somebody covering several thousand blocks in an afternoon. Less charitably, it is also the sound of a crossbow user deleting you in PvP before you have finished turning round. The clip holds a complete little arc, launch through ascent to burst, which makes it useful in any edit needing a celebration, a takeoff, or an abrupt and colourful ending.
origin: The firework rocket launch and burst from Minecraft.
